event: Iran shuts Strait of Hormuz to normal commercial traffic following coordinated US-Israeli airstrikes on Iran
War risk quotes for high-risk transits reach ~7.5%, approaching 10%+
Howden Re publishes Strait of Hormuz market report on repriced war risk
Brent physical price near peak (~$144/bbl intramonth high; dated premium to ICE Brent ~$35/bbl)
Memorandum of understanding reopens Strait toll-free; traffic stays well below normal baseline
Ceasefire breaks down; renewed attacks on commercial vessels begin (9+ vessels hit since this date)
Maritime risk executives describe conditions as a 'worst case scenario' for tankers
Vessel transits fall to ~10/day vs pre-crisis baseline of 88-130/day
Strait effectively closed to routine commercial shipping; Trump says reopening 'soon'
